gui.mdm.dimension_select.title: Select a Dimension
message.mdm.command.dimension.unsafe_id: Unsafe dimension id '%s': the path must not be "." or "..", nor contain a path separator.
message.mdm.command.dimension.create.bui: Could not build a LevelStem from template '%s'. See the server log.
message.mdm.command.dimension.reset.prev: Reset %s from source '%s' (source dimension %s, template %s). This overwrites its terrain and cannot be undone — add 'confirm' to proceed.
message.mdm.command.dimension.delete.sta: Dimension %s is defined by a datapack and cannot be deleted at runtime.
message.mdm.command.modify.spawn.not_loa: %s is not loaded, so its teleport spawn cannot be configured.
message.mdm.command.modify.spawn.unset: %s has no teleport spawn configured; /mdm tp without coordinates falls back to the surface.
message.mdm.command.modify.spawn.set: Set the teleport spawn of %s to %s.
message.mdm.command.modify.alias.not_loa: %s is not loaded, so it cannot be given an alias.
message.mdm.command.modify.alias.too_lon: Alias is too long (at most %s characters).
message.mdm.command.modify.backup.not_lo: %s is not loaded, so its backup cannot be configured.
message.mdm.command.modify.backup.unset: %s has no backup recorded (it was created from a template).
message.mdm.command.modify.backup.get: Backup of %s: source '%s', source dimension %s, template %s
message.mdm.command.modify.backup.set: Set the backup of %s to source '%s'.
message.mdm.command.modify.backup.clear: Cleared the backup of %s; it can no longer be reset.
message.mdm.command.gui.not_allowed: You cannot open the dimension selector from %s.
message.mdm.import.no_backup: %s was not imported from a backup, so it cannot be reset.
message.mdm.import.illegal_name: Illegal import name '%s': the folder must be a direct subfolder of %s/.
message.mdm.import.not_found: Cannot find '%s' (it must be placed under %s/).
message.mdm.import.no_data_tag: %s has no Data compound tag; the save format is not recognized.
message.mdm.import.undeclared_dimension: The source save '%s' does not declare dimension %s in its level.dat. Declared dimensions: %s. Pick another source dimension, or check whether this save's level.dat was trimmed.
message.mdm.import.unknown_type: Cannot determine the dimension type of %s in the source save. Specify a template as a fallback.
message.mdm.import.unknown_generator: Cannot determine the generator of %s in the source save.
message.mdm.import.unknown_extent: Cannot determine the vertical extent of %s in the source save; refusing to import. A height mismatch makes chunk sections be silently dropped, so refusing beats importing a world with missing layers.
message.mdm.import.extent_mismatch: Height mismatch, refusing to import. Source: min_y=%s height=%s; target dimension type: min_y=%s height=%s. Use a template with matching min_y/height.
message.mdm.import.no_chunks: The source save's %s has no chunk data (no .mca files in %s).
message.mdm.import.missing_folder: The source save has no %s/ folder.
